# ctrlplane_external_variable_provider (Resource)

Manages a reusable external variable provider in Ctrlplane.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the external variable provider.

### Optional

- `custom` (Block List) Provider-neutral configuration for an external variable provider type not modeled by this Terraform provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--custom))
- `statsig` (Block List) Statsig connection configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--statsig))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the external variable provider.

<a id="nestedblock--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Required:

- `config` (String) Provider-specific configuration as a JSON object.
- `type` (String) The external variable provider type.


<a id="nestedblock--statsig"></a>
### Nested Schema for `statsig`

Required:

- `endpoint` (String) The Statsig API endpoint, such as `https://api.statsig.com`.
- `token` (String) A Ctrlplane secret expression containing the Statsig server API key, such as `{{ secret "statsig-server-key" }}`.

Optional:

- `console_url` (String) Optional Statsig project console URL used to link gates back to Statsig.
